# KnowML

> Machine learning and modern AI, from first principles to the 2026 frontier. Every section answers the same six questions; every runnable code block is executed in CI; numbers are derived on the page or attributed.

## Start here

- [Browse every section](https://knowml.vercel.app/sections.html)
- [Learning roadmaps](https://knowml.vercel.app/roadmaps.html)
- [Interactive labs](https://knowml.vercel.app/labs.html)
- [Site map (graph)](https://knowml.vercel.app/map.html)
- [Where to practise](https://knowml.vercel.app/practice.html)
- [Spaced-repetition drill](https://knowml.vercel.app/review.html)

## Foundations

- [Math & Stats Foundations](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/01-math-foundations.html): Linear algebra, probability, information theory — the language everything else is written in.
- [Classical Supervised ML](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/02-classical-ml.html): Linear/logistic regression, trees, boosting, SVMs — still what wins on tabular data.
- [Unsupervised & Self-Supervised](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/03-unsupervised-self-supervised.html): Clustering, VAEs, contrastive learning — how models learn without labels.

## Neural Nets & Vision

- [Neural Network Fundamentals](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/04-neural-network-fundamentals.html): Backprop, activations, normalization, residuals — the machinery every architecture leans on.
- [CNNs & Vision Foundations](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/05-cnn-vision-foundations.html): Convolutions, ResNet, detection, segmentation — vision before transformers arrived too.
- [Modern Vision Foundation Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/06-modern-vision-foundation-models.html): CLIP, SAM, ViT-based VLMs — vision joins the foundation-model era.

## Sequence, Attention & LLMs

- [Sequence Modeling Pre-Transformer](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/07-sequence-modeling-pre-transformer.html): RNNs, LSTMs, seq2seq — the bottleneck attention was built to remove.
- [Attention & Transformers](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/08-attention-transformers.html): Query, key, value — the mechanism behind almost everything since 2018.
- [NLP Evolution](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/09-nlp-evolution.html): Bag-of-words to BERT to instruction tuning, in one line of descent.
- [LLM Architecture & Training](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/10-llm-architecture-training.html): Decoder-only transformers, scaling laws, RLHF/DPO, quantization, serving.

## Generative & Multimodal

- [RAG, Agents & Reasoning](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/11-rag-agents-reasoning.html): Why LLMs hallucinate, why retrieval helps, and how agents plan and act.
- [Generative Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/12-generative-models.html): GANs, VAEs, diffusion — how to sample from a distribution you've never seen written down.
- [Speech & Audio](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/13-speech-audio.html): ASR, TTS, speaker ID, real-time voice agents.
- [Multimodal AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/14-multimodal-ai.html): Fusing vision, audio and text into one reasoning system.

## Decision & Retrieval Systems

- [Reinforcement Learning](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/15-reinforcement-learning.html): MDPs, Q-learning, PPO — and how RLHF borrows all of it.
- [Recommenders, Ranking & Search](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/16-recommenders-ranking-search.html): The retrieval-ranking-rerank funnel, two-tower models, learning-to-rank, and the feedback loop that poisons your training data.
- [Time Series & Forecasting](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/17-time-series-forecasting.html): Why you cannot shuffle, stationarity and differencing, trees vs deep forecasting, and backtesting you can trust.
- [Graph ML](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/18-graph-ml.html): Message passing as the one primitive, GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT as variations, over-smoothing, and why splitting a graph is subtle.

## Embodied & Frontier

- [Scientific & Structured AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/19-scientific-structured-ai.html): Equivariance and inductive bias, protein structure, PINNs and neural operators, and why symmetry beats data here.
- [3D, Spatial AI & Autonomous Driving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/20-3d-spatial-autonomous-driving.html): SLAM, BEV representations, sensor fusion, closed-loop evaluation.
- [Robotics & Embodied AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/21-robotics-embodied-ai.html): VLA models, sim-to-real, diffusion policies.
- [World Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/22-world-models.html): Learned simulators, latent dynamics, the Dreamer line, and the compounding error that limits imagined rollouts.

## Systems, Safety & Interview

- [Efficient AI & Systems](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/23-efficient-ai-systems.html): FlashAttention, quantization, parallelism — making models fast and cheap.
- [ML Engineering & MLOps](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/24-mlops.html): Feature stores, drift monitoring, canary deploys — running ML in production.
- [Evaluation, Reliability & Safety](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/25-evaluation-reliability-safety.html): Calibration, hallucination, red-teaming, LLM-as-judge.
- [2026 Frontier Map](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/26-frontier-2026.html): Reasoning models, agents, world models — where the field is actually moving.
- [Interview Mastery](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/27-interview-mastery.html): The question types, the drills, and how to structure any system-design answer.
- [GPU Architecture, CUDA & Distributed Training](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/28-gpu-architecture-cuda-distributed.html): SIMT, warps, memory hierarchy, Triton, ring all-reduce — what actually happens at the hardware level.

## Hands-on

- [Fine-tuning LLMs in Practice](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/29-finetuning-llms.html): When not to fine-tune, LoRA vs QLoRA by VRAM, chat templates, and a working Unsloth pipeline.
- [Running Models Locally](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/30-running-models-locally.html): Compute the VRAM yourself, pick a quantization format and runtime, and know what your hardware can hold.
- [LLM Inference & Serving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/31-llm-inference-serving.html): Prefill vs decode, TTFT and inter-token latency, continuous batching, chunked prefill, and which engine to run.
- [Preference Optimization: RLHF, DPO & GRPO](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/32-preference-optimization.html): Reward models, the DPO derivation, group-relative advantage, verifiable rewards, and how each one breaks.

## The Labs

- [Backprop Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/backprop-lab.html): A 2-layer MLP forward then backward, one chain-rule link at a time — then every analytic gradient checked against a numerical one.
- [Tokenizer Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/tokenizer-lab.html): Build a BPE vocabulary from a tiny corpus merge by merge, then see why a word split into four tokens has no letter-level structure.
- [Attention Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/attention-lab.html): Step through MHA, KV cache, MQA, GQA, MLA, PagedAttention and FlashAttention on one worked example — every matrix computed live.
- [Sampling Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/sampling-lab.html): Logits to probabilities, then temperature, top-k and top-p on the same distribution — including where top-k and top-p disagree.
- [Quantization Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/quantization-lab.html): Quantize a weight matrix to INT8, inspect the error cell by cell, then watch one outlier consume the whole numeric range.

## Model Atlas

- [Model Atlas: Language Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/33-model-atlas-language.html): Frontier, open-weight and on-device LLMs side by side, plus embeddings, licences, cost maths and what each benchmark really measures.
- [Model Atlas: Speech & Audio](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/34-model-atlas-speech-audio.html): STT, streaming ASR, TTS, voice isolation, separation, noise suppression and diarization — with WER, RTFx, DNSMOS and SI-SDR explained.
- [Model Atlas: Vision & Generative Media](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/35-model-atlas-vision-generative.html): VLMs, detection, OCR, visual retrieval, image and video generation — the open-weight shortlist and how to read a generative benchmark.

## Grand Challenges

- [The Millennium Prize Problems](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/36-millennium-prize-problems.html): Seven problems, $1M each, six still open. P vs NP and why it justifies gradient descent, plus the September 2026 Navier–Stokes claim.
- [AI in Industry: What It Is Actually Solving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/37-ai-in-industry.html): AlphaFold's Nobel, operational AI weather, a 105,934-woman screening trial — and the claims that did not survive scrutiny.
